howto.name: Upload a WAV file
howto.text: Drop a .wav file. Uncompressed audio is the ideal source for an encode.

howto.name: PrivaTools encodes via FFmpeg
howto.text: Uncompressed source gives the encoder the best possible input. Expect roughly a 10:1 reduction.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. Expect roughly a 10:1 reduction. Keep the WAV if it is your master — MP3 is a delivery format, not an archive one.

faq.a: 192 kbps is a solid default; 256–320 kbps is near-transparent for music. MP3 is lossy, so a higher bitrate keeps more detail at the cost of a larger file.

faq.q: How much smaller will the MP3 be?
faq.a: Typically 5–11× smaller than the WAV, depending on the bitrate you pick.
FFmpeg runs on the PrivaTools server, not a third-party service. The WAV and the MP3 are temporary files that response cleanup removes after the result is sent.
